name: B10-0156/2024 – After § 131 – Am 1/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2024 in Baku, Azerbaijan (COP29)
part_text: 131a. Recalls that at COP28, countries launched the Declaration to Triple Nuclear Energy Capacity by 2050, recognising the key role of nuclear energy in reaching net zero; stresses that nuclear energy has an important role to play in enhancing EU energy sovereignty, especially in this geopolitical context;
